name: Maneaters

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.text: Ogres cause fear, except Youngbloods.

specialRules.name: Large
specialRules.text: Except for Youngbloods and Half-growns, Ogres are Large targets: any model may shoot at them even if not the closest target, with +1 to hit.

specialRules.name: Gluttony
specialRules.text: Each Ogre counts as two models when selling wyrdstone or treasure (but at least one toward the total). A captured model can be devoured, retaining his possessions and reducing the model count by one (two if a Large Target). An Ogre Hero devouring models gains 1 experience per model consumed. Any warband member or animal can be eaten; remove from roster immediately.

specialRules.name: Slow Witted
specialRules.text: Ogres improve at half rate: they need twice the usual experience for each advance.

specialRules.name: Difficult Customers
specialRules.text: Ogre Heroes suffer -1 when rolling to find Rare items not exclusive to Ogres.

specialRules.name: Cannibals
specialRules.text: May never hire Hired Swords except Halflings (Scout, Thief, etc.) and the Ogre Bodyguard, or unless stated otherwise (devoured when the contract ends).

specialRules.name: No free dagger
specialRules.text: Ogres do not get a free dagger and never fight with daggers in close combat.

items.name: Ogre club
items.note: Concussion: injury roll 2-4 treated as stunned (D6 wording, see conversionNotes); Crushing Attack with both hands: -1 to enemy armour saves and Strength counts one higher for parries

items.name: Iron fist
items.note: Parry; Gloved (occupies the hand, no double-handed weapon); Dual-role: re-roll failed parries if paired with a sword or another iron fist

items.name: Hand-held mortar
items.note: Rare 12 (Ogres only); special-equipment page says 80 + 2D6 gc. 24" range, S4. Move or fire, Prepare shot, Save Modifier, Scatter, Experimental, Explosive Radius (S4 hit to target and models within 1.5")

items.name: Lookout-Gnoblar
items.note: Rare 8. Owner gains the Dodge skill. Claimed Gnoblar (up to two different per Ogre)

items.name: Luck-Gnoblar
items.note: Rare 9. Owner may re-roll one die during the battle (never a re-roll)

items.name: Sword-Gnoblar
items.note: Rare 10. Owner gains one extra Strength 2 attack at his own WS, directed at a model the Ogre is attacking

items.name: Harpoon crossbow
items.note: Rare 10 (Ogres only). 30" range, S5, Move or fire, Prepare shot

fighters.name: Captain

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any warrior within 6" of the Captain may use his Leadership when taking Ld tests.

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.text: Causes fear.

specialRules.name: Large
specialRules.text: Large target: any model may shoot at it even if it is not the closest target, and gets +1 to hit.

fighters.notes: Exactly one Captain. Special list is the Ogre special skills.

fighters.name: Youngblood
fighters.notes: Does not cause fear and is not Large.

fighters.name: Mountain Guide

specialRules.name: Ranger
specialRules.text: If not taken out of action, may roll two dice for Exploration and pick one (not a re-roll).

specialRules.name: Loner
specialRules.text: Never claims a Gnoblar or takes one as a pet; immune to All Alone tests; may never become warband leader.

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.text: Causes fear.

specialRules.name: Large
specialRules.text: Large target: any model may shoot at it even if it is not the closest target, and gets +1 to hit.

fighters.notes: Cannot take the Maneater special skill.

fighters.name: Bull

specialRules.name: Bull Charge
specialRules.text: When charging, may make a single attack at +1 to hit instead of normal attacks; if successful the enemy is automatically knocked down.

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.text: Causes fear.

specialRules.name: Large
specialRules.text: Large target: any model may shoot at it even if it is not the closest target, and gets +1 to hit.

fighters.notes: Listed under Henchmen on the PDF.

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.text: Causes fear.

fighters.name: Sabretusk

specialRules.name: Trained
specialRules.text: Uses the Mountain Guide's Ld within 6". Requires a Guide in the warband; without one it must be left at camp.

specialRules.name: Feral Instinct
specialRules.text: At the start of the Ogre turn must pass a Ld test; if failed the opponent may move it this turn and it may charge models from its own warband.

specialRules.name: Ignored
specialRules.text: Out of action Sabretusks do not count toward out of action models for Rout tests.

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.text: Causes fear.

fighters.notes: Only allowed if the warband includes a Mountain Guide.

conversionNotes: Gnoblar 'dead on 1-2 on D6' if owner goes out of action: converted to 1-4 on D12 in intent but the Gnoblar rule text is not in specialRules (equipment note only); schema only lists 1 -> 1-2, confirm.
Ogre club Concussion 'roll of 2-4 treated as stunned' on injury left as printed (D6 injury table); needs D12 mapping.
Bulls, Half-growns and Sabretusks follow the PDF's Henchmen heading; Captain, Youngbloods and Mountain Guide are Heroes.
Hand-held mortar listed 70 gc in the equipment list but 80 + 2D6 gc (Rare 12) in its special-equipment entry; list price used. Cathayan longsword is Captain only.
Gnoblar Fighter (15 gc) is in the list with no description in the PDF.
The PDF gives a maximum-characteristics Ogre profile (M6 WS6 BS5 S5 T5 W5 I6 A5 Ld9) that the schema does not store.
